concepts.title: Kotlin พื้นฐาน: val/var, Type, String Template และ Null Safety
concepts.covers: Matches Part 1 Step 2. Part 2 setup section (h3 s18-2-setup) must show BOTH environments: (A) Windows: Android Studio Rabbit 1 (2026.2.1) installed, SDK Platform Android 16 (API 36) in SDK Manager, an AVD (Pixel-class phone, API 36 system image) created in Device Manager, Settings > Build Tools > Gradle JDK left at the bundled JBR; describe hardware rules (16 GB RAM min with Emulator, 32 GB recommended, virtualization on, GPU >= 4 GB VRAM for the Emulator, Windows on ARM unsupported). (B) WSL Ubuntu 24.04 for pure-Kotlin practice, identical to Part 1: `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y openjdk-21-jdk-headless unzip`; `mkdir -p ~/tools && cd ~/tools`; `curl -LO https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/releases/download/v2.4.21/kotlin-compiler-2.4.21.zip`; `unzip -q kotlin-compiler-2.4.21.zip`; `echo 'export PATH="$HOME/tools/kotlinc/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc`; checks `java -version` (sandbox prints `openjdk version "21.0.12.1" 2026-08-18` / `OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 21.0.12.1+1-1-24.04.4-Ubuntu)` / `OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 21.0.12.1+1-1-24.04.4-Ubuntu, mixed mode, sharing)`; say patch numbers may differ) and `kotlinc -version` -> `info: kotlinc-jvm 2.4.21 (JRE 21.0.12.1+1-1-24.04.4-Ubuntu)`; then download the jars used later into ~/projects/android-kotlin-lab/libs (same curl -L --create-dirs -o URLs as Part 1 Step 9/11 for kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm 1.11.0, kotlinx-coroutines-test-jvm 1.11.0, kotlinx-serialization-core-jvm 1.11.0, kotlinx-serialization-json-jvm 1.11.0, junit 4.13.2, hamcrest-core 1.3 from repo1.maven.org/maven2/...). Concept teaches: val vs var, type inference, Int/Long/Double/Boolean/Char/String, string templates `$name` and `${expr}`, if and when as expressions, nullable types `String?`, safe call `?.`, Elvis `?:`, why `!!` is dangerous, `toIntOrNull()`, smart cast after null check. Runnable example: ~/projects/android-kotlin-lab/concepts/c01/basics.kt that builds a note summary for somchai from nullable inputs (title may be null, tag may be null, '42' and 'abc' parsed with toIntOrNull and defaulted with ?:) and prints Thai lines; run `cd ~/projects/android-kotlin-lab/concepts/c01 && kotlinc basics.kt -include-runtime -d basics.jar && java -jar basics.jar`. Mistakes table: capture REAL kotlinc 2.4.21 messages by compiling broken variants in the sandbox (reassigning a val, calling .length on String?, type mismatch Int vs String) and a real runtime `java.lang.NullPointerException` from `!!`.

concepts.title: Class, Data Class, Sealed Interface, Extension และ Scope Functions

Runnable example: ~/projects/android-kotlin-lab/concepts/c03/uistate.kt defining `sealed interface NotesUiState { data object Loading; data object Empty; data class Success(val notes: List<Note>); data class Error(val message: String) }`, a `render(state)` function using exhaustive when, `Note.preview(max: Int)` extension that shortens long titles with '...', copy() to pin a note, apply to build a configuration object; print every state. concepts.title: Jetpack Compose พื้นฐาน: Composable, Modifier, Column/Row/Box และ Preview
concepts.covers: Matches Part 1 Step 5 (Part 1 used ProfileCard.kt; Part 2 must use a DIFFERENT example). Teaches: declarative UI, @Composable rules, Text/Button/OutlinedButton/Image(painterResource)/Spacer, Column/Row/Box with Arrangement and Alignment, Modifier chain order (padding before vs after background, clickable area), `modifier: Modifier = Modifier` convention, dp vs sp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme/typography/shapes, @Preview (showBackground, uiMode night, fontScale, widthDp), Scaffold innerPadding. Runnable example in AndroidLab: ContactCard.kt (package com.somchai.androidlab) showing a contact for somchai with an initial-letter circle (Box + CircleShape), name/email in a Column, a Row with two buttons 'โทร' and 'อีเมล' that Log.d which button was pressed; plus 3 previews (light, dark, fontScale 1.5f). Output: describe the UI precisely and show Logcat lines for the two button presses. Mistakes: `@Composable invocations can only happen from the context of a @Composable function` (calling a composable from onClick), wrong Modifier order (background not reaching edges), unresolved `dp`/`Alignment` imports, using hard-coded Color(0xFF...) instead of theme colors (dark mode looks wrong). Material3 1.4.0 no longer brings material-icons-core: if Icons.Filled.* is used, add `androidx.compose.material:material-icons-core` (no version, BOM manages it) or avoid icons like Part 1 did.

concepts.title: State และ Recomposition: remember, rememberSaveable, TextField และ State Hoisting
concepts.covers: Matches Part 1 Step 6 (Part 1 used QuickNote.kt with QuickNoteScreen + NoteTitleField; Part 2 must use a different example). Teaches: state drives UI, recomposition, mutableStateOf/mutableIntStateOf with `by` (imports androidx.compose.runtime.getValue/setValue), remember vs rememberSaveable (rotation, process death), OutlinedTextField value/onValueChange/label/isError/supportingText/keyboardOptions, stateless vs stateful composables, state hoisting (state down, events up), derivedStateOf, side-effect APIs by name (LaunchedEffect, rememberCoroutineScope, DisposableEffect). Runnable example: NoteComposer.kt with a stateful `NoteComposerScreen` holding title + content + savedCount via rememberSaveable and a stateless `NoteForm(title, content, onTitleChange, onContentChange, onSave, titleError)`; Save is disabled while the title is blank; title > 50 chars shows the error 'ชื่อโน้ตต้องยาวไม่เกิน 50 ตัวอักษร'; Log.d on save. Output: describe UI, Logcat lines for two saves, and the rotation experiment (rememberSaveable keeps text, remember loses it). Mistakes: plain `var count = 0` never updates the UI, mutableStateOf without remember (lint: `Creating a state object during composition without using remember`), missing getValue/setValue imports with `by`, TextField that ignores typing because onValueChange does not update state, adding to a MutableList inside state (UI not updated; use a new List or mutableStateListOf).

concepts.title: Navigation Compose แบบ Type-safe
concepts.covers: Matches Part 1 Step 8 (Part 1: Navigation.kt with `@Serializable data object NoteListRoute`, `@Serializable data class NoteDetailRoute(val noteId: Int)`, AndroidLabNavHost, NoteDetailScreen, TextButton 'กลับ'). Setup lines are EXACTLY Part 1's: libs.versions.toml `androidx-navigation-compose = { group = "androidx.navigation", name = "navigation-compose", version.ref = "navigation" }`, `kotlinx-serialization-json = { group = "org.jetbrains.kotlinx", name = "kotlinx-serialization-json", version.ref = "kotlinxSerialization" }`, plugin `kotlin-serialization = { id = "org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.serialization", version.ref = "kotlin" }`; root build `alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.serialization) apply false`; app plugins add `alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.serialization)`; deps `implementation(libs.androidx.navigation.compose)`, `implementation(libs.kotlinx.serialization.json)`. Part 2 example: bottom navigation app with routes `NotesTabRoute` (data object), `SettingsTabRoute` (data object) and `NoteDetailRoute(noteId: Int)`; NavigationBar + NavigationBarItem with labels 'โน้ต' and 'ตั้งค่า' (the required icon slot gets a small Text such as "N"/"S", or add material-icons-core), selected tab from `navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState()` + `currentDestination?.hierarchy?.any { it.hasRoute(NotesTabRoute::class) } == true` (imports androidx.navigation.NavDestination.Companion.hasRoute and androidx.navigation.NavDestination.Companion.hierarchy), navigate with popUpTo(startDestination) { saveState = true }, launchSingleTop = true, restoreState = true; detail screen reads `backStackEntry.toRoute<NoteDetailRoute>()` (import androidx.navigation.toRoute). Output: Logcat lines for tab switches and opening/closing a detail page; explain the back stack after each action. Mention honestly (verified Oct 2026): the androidx.navigation release page says the library is in maintenance mode (critical fixes only) and Navigation 3 1.2.0 is the stable Compose-first library; the curriculum still teaches Navigation Compose 2.10.2. Mistakes: forgetting the serialization plugin -> app crashes with `kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException: Serializer for class 'NoteDetailRoute' is not found.` + `Please ensure that class is marked as '@Serializable' and that the serialization compiler plugin is applied.` (real text), duplicated [libraries] header in TOML breaks Gradle sync, tapping the same tab stacks copies (fix launchSingleTop), passing whole objects instead of ids.

mini_project.name: Notes App (แอปจดโน้ต Android ด้วย Kotlin + Jetpack Compose)
mini_project.summary: Portfolio-grade offline notes app built in a NEW Android Studio project NotesApp at C:\Users\somchai\AndroidStudioProjects\NotesApp (Empty Activity template, applicationId/package com.somchai.notes, Kotlin DSL, minSdk 24, compileSdk 36, targetSdk 36), Material 3 UI in Jetpack Compose, MVVM with ViewModel + StateFlow + unidirectional data flow, Room database, DataStore settings, type-safe Navigation Compose, manual dependency injection (AppContainer held by NotesApplication), JVM unit tests and Compose UI tests, and a signed release Android App Bundle (app-release.aab) built with R8. Published as https://github.com/somchai/notes-app with a README. Part 1 Step 13 already showed the folder tree, AppContainer/NotesApplication code and the git push commands; Part 4 must follow them exactly.
features: Note model: `data class Note(val id: Long, val title: String, val content: String, val pinned: Boolean, val createdAt: Long, val updatedAt: Long)` in data/Note.kt; Room `NoteEntity` in data/local with table `notes` (columns id INTEGER PK autoGenerate, title, content, pinned, created_at, updated_at), database file `notes.db`, version 1, exportSchema = true with the Room Gradle Plugin (plugin id androidx.room, version.ref room) and `room { schemaDirectory("$projectDir/schemas") }`, schemas folder committed

NoteDao: `observeNotes(query: String): Flow<List<NoteEntity>>` with `WHERE title LIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR content LIKE '%' || :query || '%' ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC`; `suspend fun getNote(id: Long): NoteEntity?`; `@Upsert suspend fun upsert(note: NoteEntity): Long`; `@Delete suspend fun delete(note: NoteEntity)`; `suspend fun setPinned(id: Long, pinned: Boolean)`

NoteRepository interface + OfflineNoteRepository(dao) mapping entities to Note; SettingsRepository on DataStore file `settings` with keys `theme_mode` ("system"|"light"|"dark") and `sort_order` ("updated"|"title")

Note list screen (ui/notes): TopAppBar 'โน้ตของฉัน' with TextButton 'ตั้งค่า', search OutlinedTextField (ViewModel applies debounce(300) to the query), LazyColumn with key = id, pinned notes first, card shows title, first line of content and a 'ปักหมุด' label, pin toggle, FAB with Text("+") (no material-icons dependency), empty state 'ยังไม่มีโน้ต กดปุ่ม + เพื่อเริ่มจด' and no-result state 'ไม่พบโน้ตที่ตรงกับ "<คำค้น>"'

Editor screen (ui/editor) for create and edit: title (required, trimmed, max 50 chars, errors 'กรุณาใส่ชื่อโน้ต' and 'ชื่อโน้ตต้องยาวไม่เกิน 50 ตัวอักษร' from NoteValidator) and multi-line content; Save returns to the list; Delete (edit mode only) asks with AlertDialog 'ลบโน้ตนี้ไหม' and after deleting the list shows a Snackbar 'ลบโน้ตแล้ว' with action 'เลิกทำ' that restores the note; NoteEditorViewModel reads the id with `savedStateHandle.toRoute<NoteEditorRoute>()` (0L = new note)

Settings screen (ui/settings): theme radio buttons (ตามระบบ / สว่าง / มืด) and sort order (แก้ไขล่าสุด / ชื่อ ก-ฮ, A-Z) saved in DataStore; MainActivity collects theme_mode and passes darkTheme to NotesTheme; sort order applied in NoteListViewModel

Type-safe navigation in ui/navigation/NotesNavHost.kt: `@Serializable data object NoteListRoute`, `@Serializable data class NoteEditorRoute(val noteId: Long = 0L)`, `@Serializable data object SettingsRoute`; system back works everywhere

Architecture: one UiState data class per screen (NoteListUiState, NoteEditorUiState, SettingsUiState) exposed as StateFlow via stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), ...); ViewModel factories via `viewModelFactory { initializer { val app = this[APPLICATION_KEY] as NotesApplication; ... } }` (+ createSavedStateHandle() for the editor)

Tests: src/test (JVM): FakeNoteRepository, MainDispatcherRule (TestWatcher calling Dispatchers.setMain/resetMain), NoteValidatorTest (>= 4 tests), NoteListViewModelTest (>= 4 tests: loading then content, search filters title and content, sort by title, toggle pin) using kotlinx-coroutines-test (optionally Turbine 1.2.1); src/androidTest: NoteListScreenTest (empty state text visible; list shows given titles; FAB click calls callback) and NoteEditorScreenTest (saving a blank title shows the error) with createComposeRule
